what: US Foods distributes food and supplies to restaurants, hospitals, schools and hotels. It is the second-largest foodservice distributor in the United States after Sysco.
customers: Independent restaurants above all, plus chains, healthcare and education caterers and hospitality operators.
money: food, equipment and supplies delivered to kitchens
moat: A warehouse and delivery network reaching hundreds of thousands of kitchens, with own-brand products that independent restaurants cannot buy elsewhere.
risks: Net margin of about 2% is thin, as is normal in distribution
Restaurant traffic falls when consumers cut back on eating out
Debt of about $5 billion against almost no cash
opportunities: Independent restaurants, its most profitable customers, grow faster than chains
Own-brand products carry better margins than national brands
watch: Independent restaurant case growth and gross profit per case.
